issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning int, while the template comments and the solution implement and recommend a double return type for more precise calculation. This inconsistency can confuse students about which return type to implement and may lead to compilation or test failures if they follow the UML instead of the template hint.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Either update the UML in the problem statement to show getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (preferred for precision) or change the template comment and the solution to use int. Ensure the textual task description, UML, template comments, and tests all agree on the chosen return type.
